name: Flythroughs
title: lumalabs.ai/flythroughs
shortDescription: Flythroughs by Luma AI allows users to create professional 3D flythrough videos using just an iPhone. This tool is designed for real estate agents, interior designers, and anyone looking to showcase their space effectively. Users can record a simple video and transform it into a cinematic experience, showcasing their listings in a compelling and immersive way.
pros: No need for expensive or specialized equipment
cons: Dependent on the quality of initial video recording
May require good lighting conditions to work best
